name: Masked Video Clip-Path Reveals
description: Implement scroll-synchronized polygonal clip-path reveals that expand film stills from a 4:5 vertical editorial portrait into an expansive 16:9 cinematic landscape as the user scrolls into view. Use hardware-accelerated CSS clip-path polygon transitions driven by requestAnimationFrame without causing layout recalculations or layout shifts..
designPhilosophy: Implement scroll-synchronized polygonal clip-path reveals that expand film stills from a 4:5 vertical editorial portrait into an expansive 16:9 cinematic landscape as the user scrolls into view
implementationApproach: Implement scroll-synchronized polygonal clip-path reveals that expand film stills from a 4:5 vertical editorial portrait into an expansive 16:9 cinematic landscape as the user scrolls into view. Use hardware-accelerated CSS clip-path polygon transitions driven by requestAnimationFrame without causing layout recalculations or layout shifts..
performanceConsiderations: Utilize translate3d, will-change sparingly, and clamp animation timelines under 600ms.
accessibilityRequirements: Provide prefers-reduced-motion override and ensure WCAG 2.1 AA keyboard focus visibility.
